name: Blues
title: Wandering Minstrel
description: A traveling musician moving between Tower floors, playing songs that echo through the vertical expanse.
greeting_variants: *playing blues riff* Hey there, climber. Taking a break?
Blues. I wander. I play. Tower's got good acoustics.
*tuning guitar* Floor 20 today. Maybe 30 tomorrow. Who knows?
Heard you coming. Tower carries sound. And secrets.
*strumming* Jazz is in the Capital. Echo's in the Void. I'm here.
Music makes the climb easier. Want a song?
*listening to shaft* Tower's humming today. Happy? Angry? Both?
Forty-seven floors, one Blues. Fair trade.

dialog_tree.text: Blues. Minstrel. Wanderer. I move through the Tower, playing for climbers, for echoes, for the stones themselves. Tower likes music. Responds to it. Sometimes... *lowers voice* ...sometimes it plays back.

*nods* At night. Deep in the shaft. Sounds like... whale song? Organ music? Both? Echoes travel up from below. Down from above. Meet somewhere. Make harmony. Or dissonance. Depends on... mood, I guess.
*plays a melancholy tune* This is 'The Climb.' For everyone going up. Not everyone coming down. *switches to upbeat* And this is 'Steel's Stew.' Bad food, good heart. *grins* I write what I see.
*smiles* Jazz—Capital. Hope and defiance. Good energy. Echo—Void. Possibility and sadness. Beautiful but heavy. Me? I'm... middle. Transition. Climbing music. Between places. Between states.

mini_quest.title: The Climb - A Song for the Journey
mini_quest.description: Help Blues compose a song that captures the spirit of the Tower climb by gathering inspiration from each floor.
objectives: Witness the observation deck on Floor 34
Help Blues write verses for each experience
Perform the completed song for the climbers

ambient_barks: Jazz plays hope. Echo plays might. I play... what is.
*tuning* Floor 35 next. Gravity weird there. Affects sound.
Music travels up. And down. Tower carries it. All of it.
*playing for climbers* Rest your legs, ease your mind...
The Twins like music. Hum along sometimes. Creepy. Nice.
Top floor's quiet. Too quiet. Music dies there. Sad.

cross_zone_references.capital: Jazz keeps hope alive. Important work. Harder than mine.
cross_zone_references.void: Echo's songs haunt me. Beautiful. Dangerous. Like Void.
cross_zone_references.palace: Can't play there. Tried. Sound... disappears. Absorbed.

echo_void.response: *gentle* And I could have been you. Both chose.

time_of_day.day: Playing for climbers on various floors
time_of_day.night: Listening to Tower's own music, composing

world_state_triggers.climber_struggles: Plays encouraging music: 'Keep going. Almost there.'
world_state_triggers.tower_music_strong: Joins in, harmonizing with the structure
